body: Worker trap (Termal::BarA1, 2026-10-18, met on the w-52222f575b81 carry). TermAl's blobs are LF, but .git/config sets core.autocrlf=true, so a checkout (reset --hard, checkout, apply) writes CRLF files to disk. git diff --cached reads a stat-clean working-tree file instead of its blob. With CRLF files on disk, the staged-diff bytes therefore depend on autocrlf: the Engram schema-1 script (run with core.autocrlf=false) and the pinned `termal.exe review-freeze-check` (repository config, true) compute different fingerprints. The check fails with "review input drifted from the independently supplied fingerprint", although the tree is identical. FIX: before freezing, normalize the changed files on disk to LF (`perl -pi -e 's/\r\n/\n/' FILES`), restage with `git -c core.autocrlf=false add -- FILES` (the tree is unchanged; verify with write-tree), then freeze. The script and the checker then agree. Diagnose by comparing `git -c core.autocrlf=true diff --cached --stat` with the false form: a whole-file rewrite under false means CRLF files on disk. Also: Git Bash `grep -c $'\r'` miscounts CRs; count with `tr -cd '\r' | wc -c`.
